title: Accelerated Track Registered Nursing: LVN to ADN

why: the record names the degree total and the Butte Local pattern, but no units for it

outcomes: Adhere to standards of professional practice and practice within legal, ethical and regulatory framework.
Demonstrate effective verbal, non-verbal, and written communication using compassion and cultural awareness resulting in trusting relationships.
Provide comprehensive assessments with a holistic view of the client using the functional health assessment.
Demonstrate evidenced-based practice and the use of critical thinking based on the nursing process to provide the foundation for appropriate clinical decision making.
Adapt care when providing nursing interventions to assist the clients in achieving desired outcomes.
Develop individualized teaching plan based on assessed needs.
Demonstrate decision-making coordination with the client, significant support person(s) and members of the healthcare team.

Demonstrate effective management through gathering information, planning, and directing in collaboration with the healthcare team to assist the client to move toward positive outcomes in an efficient and cost-effective manner.

notes: Closed list stores 'NSG10' without a space; the catalog prints 'NSG 10' (1.50 units). Treated as the same closed-list course, not a catalog addition.
Section heading as printed is 'Nursing: LVN to ADN'; the description names the award 'Associate Degree in Accelerated Track Registered Nursing: LVN to ADN'.

degree_total 60-63 is taken from the 'Map (Butte GE)' sequence ('Units: 60.00- 63.00', 'Total : 60.00- 63.00'), which includes GE area choices and an elective; reviewer should confirm a degree map total counts as the award's degree total.
degree_elective_units 21.5 is the map's 'Elective (any course numbered 1-199 or C1000-C2999)' line, which the page says is 'Only necessary if the 60 units needed to graduate have not been completed.'
The map prints individual GE area choices (Area 2 3-5, Area 3 3-4, Area 6 3) but no total for the GE pattern, so ge_units is null.

Admission prerequisites (CMST 4 or COMM C1000, ENGL C1000 or ENGL C1000E, FN 2, PSYC C1000, BIOL 15, BIOL 20, BIOL 21) are listed as application prerequisites, not major requirements, and were not placed in blocks.
